# UX review: PASS (source only)

Reviewed the first-fix source in `/workspace/android-studio-reference-membership`
on `android-studio-task/1-reference-runner-membership`, based on
`c1ce5ca16a26fd59984b50500ead45fbafafa5c8`.
The membership module is 67,144 bytes with SHA-256
`fef14bc8bc85bb76ed9b88578bbeb4390f2d409403b6fcda87e8d040aecb47d9`.

No blocking UX findings.

The CLI requires all three paths and exposes an explicit check mode. Documentation
shows complete create/check commands and explains that creation refuses an existing
output while checking requires identical evidence and never writes. Input errors
identify immutable-pin, complete-source, path, regular-file and budget boundaries.
Authored regressions cover required arguments, unchanged existing outputs, mismatched
checks and missing check inputs; this review did not execute them.

Evidence keeps declared source inputs and conditional producer relationships distinct
from compiled membership and runtime counts, both of which remain null. Applicability
is unresolved, global census completion is false, archive membership re-verification
is false, and original behavior credit is zero. Unsupported syntax/configuration
retains unresolved evidence. Runner and producer observations preserve source identity,
provenance and byte spans. The task documentation and fixture README repeat these
limits without claiming that discovery regressions port original behavior.

All 16 complete originals match the immutable selected lengths and SHA-256 hashes.
The canonical 95-row ledger, reference manifest, and existing census/JUnit4 modules
are byte-identical to the protected task base. Dispatch is additive.

This verdict covers source-level developer workflow and report clarity. All 19
membership Rust tests, normal compilation, real CLI create/check/error flows,
repository checks, full app and current workspace CI remain pending actual validation.
No app UI, Android Studio workflow, exhaustive census, startup, memory or original
test parity claim is made.

The reviewer made no source, Git, Cargo, compiler, cache, SDK, app or fixture changes.
Only these external review files were created. Read hold released.
